title: M3: The web app in a Link session through apricity serve --link
description:
## Purpose
A page can't join Link, so `apricity serve --link` joins the session and passes its clock to the web app over a WebSocket. The page maps that clock onto its `AudioContext` and the AudioWorklet's mixer follows it (M1), so the web app plays beside the DAW like `apricity play --link`.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-cli/src/serve.rs`: `--link` flag, one peer (`apricity-link`), WebSocket route `/link` streaming clock messages and answering pings, `custom.apricity.link.url` in `amplify_outputs.json`.
- `schema/link-clock.schema.json`: the wire messages (clock, ping, pong, error), validated in Rust and TypeScript tests.
- `web/src/audio/link-clock.ts` (new): WebSocket client, clock offset from ping/pong, server time to `AudioContext` frames.
- `web/src/audio/player.ts`, `engine-worklet.ts`, `render-worker.ts`: clock lines to the worklet, arranging at the session's tempo, start and stop from the session, re-aligning after a loss.
- The UI's needs, filed for the web session (label `web`), not built here.

## Out of scope
The cloud-hosted app (decided from M0's finding on reaching `ws://127.0.0.1` from https); `server.py` (retiring, apricitus-8cecf2); visual design.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant D as DAW (peer)
  participant S as apricity serve --link (peer)
  participant P as page (link-clock.ts)
  participant W as AudioWorklet (Mixer)
  D-->>S: Link session: tempo, beat, start/stop
  P->>S: ping t
  S-->>P: pong t, server time
  S-->>P: clock: tempo, beat at server time, playing, peers
  P->>W: clock line (beat at context frame)
  W-->>P: status (position, pending)
```

## Definition of Done
1. `features/link/serve.feature` (Rust tests in `serve.rs`, as `features/serve/serve.feature` does) and `features/link/browser.feature` (node tests) green; 100% coverage of new code.
2. Rust and TypeScript share the message contract (the schema); no Python.
3. Schema added and validated in both test suites.
4. CLI: `serve --link` with help text; `/link` without `--link` answers 404 saying how to turn it on.
5. Fixtures: example messages in `features/link/fixtures/`.
6. `design/link.md` "Browser clock" section with the sequence above.
7. Docs: `docs/tools.md` web app section; `docs/concepts.md` Link section gains the browser paragraph.
8. Web: the UI-needs task is filed and linked.
9. Verify: `cargo test -p apricity-cli serve` (safe-run prefix), `cd web && npx tsx --test test/link-clock.test.ts` (also added to `test:flow`), `node web/test/wasm.test.mjs`, `scripts/serve-smoke.sh`; manual check in Chrome, Safari and Firefox with a DAW, logged.
10. Running log. 11. `feat(<task id>)`; not breaking (`custom.apricity.link` is additive). 12. Depends on M1 and M2; relates apricitus-92b5b5 (ws from the page), apricitus-205813.
